name: Ephesus
description: Ephesus is a ruined Greek and Roman port city near Selçuk, in western Türkiye, once among the Mediterranean's great cities. Walk its marble streets to the towering facade of the Library of Celsus and a Great Theatre that held about 24,000 spectators. Little survives of the nearby Temple of Artemis, a Seven Wonders site, but pilgrims still visit the House of the Virgin Mary.
